messages:
elaine: On a call with Meridian POC — streaming answer cuts off mid-JSON, Android client throws "Unterminated object". Demo paused.

aj: Suspect proxy/chunking. Any 429s?

elaine: Yes, small 429 spikes before disconnects. Client v1.1.2. Server shows 200 then FIN ~300ms.

sam: Quick options: 1) disable proxy buffering for their route, 2) send explicit keepalive events (`event: keepalive
data: {}`), 3) ask client to aggregate `data:` lines.

aj: I'll patch a tenant-scoped nginx config and add verbose `--sse-frame` logs to runtime canary.

ops-bot: Canary deploy started: config/nginx/meridian-buffer-off @ sha:deaf00d (1/2 hosts) :gear:

elaine: Customer will test after SDK bump to v1.1.3 (better SSE parsing). Will report back in 15m.

sam: Also temporarily relaxed rate limits for tenant=meridian for 30m to avoid retry storms.

elaine: Thanks — if green, I'll update the deal notes and close the support ticket. :thumbsup:
